plain: A rule made by a town, club, or company to govern itself.

webster.text: A town law; the law of a city, town or private corporation.

example.quote: The by-laws of such an institution as a bank can operate only on its own members can only concern the disposition of its own property, and must essentially resemble the rules of a private mercantile partnership.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, Opinion as to the Constitutionality of the Bank of the United States, Feb. 23, 1791
